# Havoc Global

> Havoc Global is a lifestyle: an experience lived through its brands. A London fashion house founded by Oliver Hevicon, home of Defiant Attitude, A.C.H Kidz and Hevicon.

## Brands
- Defiant Attitude: clothing for men and women, designed in London. Opens 7 December 2026. https://defiantattitude.com
- A.C.H Kidz: childrenswear for ages 5 to 12, inspired by Alysha Catherine Hevicon. Opens 8 December 2026. https://achkidz.com
- Hevicon: everyday wardrobe designed in London. Coming soon. https://hevicon.co.uk

## Founder
Oliver Hevicon. Born in Manchester; spent part of his childhood in Hong Kong, where his father was a supplier in the clothing trade; started Havoc Global in London.
